items.heading: Peka
details: Key ingredients: octopus or lamb, potato, vegetables, olive oil
Arrange meat or seafood with potatoes and vegetables in a heavy pan.
Cover with a domed lid (peka) and surround with hot coals.
Cook slowly, occasionally rotating the coals for even heat.
Uncover to reveal tender, smoky meat and vegetables.

items.heading: Cevapi Croatian Style
details: Key ingredients: minced beef and pork, onion, ajvar, flatbread
Mix minced beef and pork with onion and seasoning.
Shape into small grilled sausages.
Grill over high heat until well charred.
Serve in warm flatbread with chopped onion and ajvar pepper relish.
